title: Framework Engineering boundary synthesis
findings: The distinct-discipline interpretation of FEH-001 is not supported.
No single adjacent field fully subsumes the exact object-and-integration boundary.
Adjacent fields collectively cover every identified FE mechanism.
The best current normative model is a candidate integrated engineering profile.
The accurate maturity description is a repository-centered research program.
Incremental utility remains the decisive untested hypothesis.
limitations: broad but not formally systematic literature review
decision_proposal: Preserve profile v1.0, narrow present-tense claims, and execute the matched incremental-utility study before expanding infrastructure.
